title: Deeper/broader DWG AcDs association, peer fallback, and native consumer boundaries
mode: primary-source web research and read-only local plan/test-owner reconciliation
scope: Crosswalk the ODA v5.4.1 AcDb:AcDsPrototype_1b DataStorage layout with the current LibreDWG implementation path
Recheck current FreeCAD and OpenCADStudio release routes for their ability to qualify DWG/DXF carrier preservation versus ACIS semantics
Refine the existing PAR-07/S8 implementation sequence without creating duplicate tests, findings, or validation dependencies

method.limitations: ODA v5.4.1 is the normative source for the DWG byte layout, but its DataStorage chapter is historical and exact producer/version behavior still requires exact authored samples. LibreDWG master is mutable and was inspected through public source pages only; no immutable checkout or executable comparison was made. FreeCAD documentation is archived route documentation, not current-build runtime qualification. OpenCADStudio v2026.42 release notes and lockfile identify advertised workflows and source pins but do not establish runtime ACIS/AcDs semantics. No local parser, peer, or native application was run.

sources.project: Open Design Alliance Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
sources.observed: The file header identifies segment-index, DataIndex, schema-index, and search segments. DataIndex entries point to segment/local offset/schema. Data record headers carry a UInt64 handle and local offset. Data records may be inline or use the 0xbb106bb1 blob-reference sentinel and ordered Blob01 pages. The spec says search data may be ignored when reading but that AutoCAD ignores the entity if schema-search data is not created. It documents version-dependent SAB suffixes.
sources.limits: The PDF describes a 2012-era R2013 DataStorage layout and explicitly scopes detailed ACIS/SAB semantics out. It is not a substitute for exact version/producer samples or geometric validation.

sources.observed: The AcDs schema describes parsing the segment catalogue and indexes/schema/search structures; _data_ and blob01 segment bodies are left unhandled there. The R2007 decoder separately scans decompressed section bytes for ACIS BinaryFile and End-of-ASM-data and attaches found streams to queued ACIS-solid handles in encounter order. This fallback is not equivalent to the ODA DataIndex/record-handle/page-chain join.
sources.limits: No immutable master commit was pinned or built, and no runtime association outcome was tested. Do not generalize the source observation to every released LibreDWG binary.

sources.revision: Published repository pages reviewed 2026-10-20; documentation repository reports archived
sources.observed: The documented DWG workflow converts DWG to DXF and then invokes one of the selectable DXF importers. The Draft DXF page states that ACIS/SAT solid blobs cannot currently be read by stock FreeCAD importers.
sources.limits: This is route documentation, not qualification of a current Windows/Linux FreeCAD build, selected importer, converter binary, or any specific libdxfrw output. It cannot provide ACIS semantic evidence.

sources.revision: OpenCADStudio v2026.42 released 2026-10-18 at b6fbac3; locked acadrust 0.6.4 at 5d4f11ae38758caec540bc9819ff2c4120eeadb4 and opencadkernel at a60f18ff033b5a3f7d842e2398f393e4d6cfcd32
sources.observed: Release notes advertise a separate SAT/ACIS model import workflow. The locked graph uses the ACadRust-family codec and OpenCADKernel; the kernel README characterizes the project as early and says most operations are not written yet.
sources.limits: A standalone SAT import is not evidence for DWG AcDs owner/key association. Shared ACadRust-family lineage and unrun release binaries prevent counting this as an independent DWG parser or semantic oracle. It remains an optional application-level observer if an exact build and locally generated expected-profile input are later tested.

decision.planDelta: Strengthen PAR-07/S8 evidence ordering to require segment/DataIndex validation, record-header-handle resolution, complete direct/blob page-chain reconstruction, entity/owner join, and separate search-schema visibility. Keep LibreDWG marker scanning non-authoritative; FreeCAD native qualification is limited to its selected documented DXF subset; OpenCADStudio is optional and cannot independently promote DWG AcDs or ACIS semantics. Reuse existing local bounds/blob/DataIndex-order tests, keep fast-first validation, and self-unblock after external NOT_RUN outcomes.
